ten: Word – Chương 5: Đồ họa (ảnh, hình, SmartArt, biểu đồ) – Đề 1
ten_en: Word – Chapter 5: Insert and format graphic elements – Test 1

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file C5D1_P1_Weekdays.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới. File phụ (ảnh, dữ liệu, 3D Models) nằm cùng thư mục bài làm.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open C5D1_P1_Weekdays.docx and complete the tasks below in order. Extra files (pictures, data, 3D Models) are in the same work folder.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Thêm mô tả alt text “Weekdays workflow” cho sơ đồ SmartArt trong mục “Facts about Saturday and Sunday”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Add the alt text description “Weekdays workflow” to the SmartArt graphic in the “Facts about Saturday and Sunday” section.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Bấm vào viền ngoài SmartArt > nhấp phải > Edit Alt Text.  2) Nhập: Weekdays workflow.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Click the outer border of the SmartArt > right-click > Edit Alt Text.  2) Type: Weekdays workflow.

cham.de_bai: Add the alt text description “Weekdays workflow” to the SmartArt graphic in the “Facts about Saturday and Sunday” section.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Chuyển tiêu đề tài liệu thành WordArt kiểu Fill: Black, Text color 1; Shadow.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Convert the document title to WordArt by using the Fill: Black, Text color 1; Shadow style.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn tiêu đề tài liệu.  2) Insert > WordArt > Fill: Black, Text color 1; Shadow.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the document title.  2) Insert > WordArt > Fill: Black, Text color 1; Shadow.

cham.de_bai: Convert the document title to WordArt by using the Fill: Black, Text color 1; Shadow style.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Đặt text box bắt đầu bằng “Did” ở vị trí Top Left của trang với kiểu ngắt dòng Square.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Position the text box that starts with “Did” in the Top Left of the page with square text wrapping.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn khung text box.  2) Shape Format > Position > Position in Top Left with Square Text Wrapping.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the text box.  2) Shape Format > Position > Position in Top Left with Square Text Wrapping.

cham.de_bai: Position the text box that starts with “Did” in the Top Left of the page with square text wrapping.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Facts about Saturday and Sunday”, áp dụng hiệu ứng hình Soft Round Bevel cho sơ đồ SmartArt (nhớ chọn toàn bộ sơ đồ SmartArt).
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Facts about Saturday and Sunday” section, apply the Soft Round Bevel shape effect to the SmartArt graphic (be sure to select the entire SmartArt graphic).
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Bấm vào viền ngoài SmartArt, sau đó Ctrl+A để chọn tất cả các hình bên trong.  2) Format > Shape Effects > Bevel > Soft Round.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Click the outer border of the SmartArt, then press Ctrl+A to select all shapes inside.  2) Format > Shape Effects > Bevel > Soft Round.

cham.de_bai: In the “Facts about Saturday and Sunday” section, apply the Soft Round Bevel shape effect to the SmartArt graphic (be sure to select the entire SmartArt graphic).

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong sơ đồ SmartArt ở mục “Facts about Saturday and Sunday”, đổi chữ “Saturday” thành “Saturday (Step 2)”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the SmartArt graphic in the “Facts about Saturday and Sunday” section, change the text “Saturday” to “Saturday (Step 2)”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn SmartArt > SmartArt Design > Text Pane.  2) Sửa dòng "Saturday" thành "Saturday (Step 2)".
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the SmartArt > SmartArt Design > Text Pane.  2) Change the line "Saturday" to "Saturday (Step 2)".

cham.de_bai: In the SmartArt graphic in the “Facts about Saturday and Sunday” section, change the text “Saturday” to “Saturday (Step 2)”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Moaning about Mondays”, áp dụng shape style Moderate Effect - Gold, Accent 4 cho text box bắt đầu bằng “Did”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Moaning about Mondays” section, apply the Moderate Effect - Gold, Accent 4 shape style to the text box that starts with “Did”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn khung text box (bấm vào viền).  2) Shape Format > Shape Styles > Moderate Effect - Gold, Accent 4.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the text box (click its border).  2) Shape Format > Shape Styles > Moderate Effect - Gold, Accent 4.

cham.de_bai: In the “Moaning about Mondays” section, apply the Moderate Effect - Gold, Accent 4 shape style to the text box that starts with “Did”.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file C5D1_P2_Pharma.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới. File phụ (ảnh, dữ liệu, 3D Models) nằm cùng thư mục bài làm.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open C5D1_P2_Pharma.docx and complete the tasks below in order. Extra files (pictures, data, 3D Models) are in the same work folder.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong sơ đồ SmartArt ở mục “Active Ingredients”, hạ cấp “Filling” để thành mục cấp hai dưới “Blending”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the SmartArt graphic in the “Active Ingredients” section, demote “Filling” so that it becomes a second-level item under “Blending”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Bấm chọn hình "Filling" (hoặc đặt con trỏ ở dòng đó trong Text Pane).  2) SmartArt Design > Demote (hoặc nhấn Tab trong Text Pane).
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Click the "Filling" shape (or put the cursor on that line in the Text Pane).  2) SmartArt Design > Demote (or press Tab in the Text Pane).

cham.de_bai: In the SmartArt graphic in the “Active Ingredients” section, demote “Filling” so that it becomes a second-level item under “Blending”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong sơ đồ SmartArt ở mục “Active Ingredients”, di chuyển hình “Filling” lên đứng trước “Blending”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the SmartArt graphic in the “Active Ingredients” section, move the “Filling” shape so that it appears before “Blending”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Bấm chọn hình "Filling".  2) SmartArt Design > Move Up.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Click the "Filling" shape.  2) SmartArt Design > Move Up.

cham.de_bai: In the SmartArt graphic in the “Active Ingredients” section, move the “Filling” shape so that it appears before “Blending”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Thêm mô tả alt text “Pharma image” cho ảnh trong mục “Fill Material”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Add the alt text description “Pharma image” to the picture in the “Fill Material” section.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Nhấp phải ảnh > View Alt Text.  2) Nhập "Pharma image" vào ô mô tả.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Right-click the picture > View Alt Text.  2) Type "Pharma image" in the description box.

cham.de_bai: Add the alt text description “Pharma image” to the picture in the “Fill Material” section.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Fill Material”, áp dụng hiệu ứng 10 Point Soft Edges cho ảnh.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Fill Material” section, apply the 10 Point Soft Edges effect to the picture.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn ảnh.  2) Picture Format > Picture Effects > Soft Edges > 10 Point.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the picture.  2) Picture Format > Picture Effects > Soft Edges > 10 Point.

cham.de_bai: In the “Fill Material” section, apply the 10 Point Soft Edges effect to the picture.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Fill Material”, áp dụng hiệu ứng nghệ thuật (artistic effect) Cement cho ảnh.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Fill Material” section, apply the Cement artistic effect to the picture.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn ảnh.  2) Picture Format > Artistic Effects > Cement.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the picture.  2) Picture Format > Artistic Effects > Cement.

cham.de_bai: In the “Fill Material” section, apply the Cement artistic effect to the picture.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file C5D1_P3_Bank.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới. File phụ (ảnh, dữ liệu, 3D Models) nằm cùng thư mục bài làm.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open C5D1_P3_Bank.docx and complete the tasks below in order. Extra files (pictures, data, 3D Models) are in the same work folder.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Thêm viền 6 pt màu Blue, Accent 1 cho ảnh trong mục “Savings Account”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Add a 6 pt Blue, Accent 1 border to the picture in the “Savings Account” section.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn ảnh.  2) Picture Format > Picture Border > Blue, Accent 1.  3) Picture Border > Weight > 6 pt.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the picture.  2) Picture Format > Picture Border > Blue, Accent 1.  3) Picture Border > Weight > 6 pt.

cham.de_bai: Add a 6 pt Blue, Accent 1 border to the picture in the “Savings Account” section.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Áp dụng SmartArt style Moderate Effect cho sơ đồ SmartArt trong mục “Banking Fees”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Apply the Moderate Effect SmartArt style to the SmartArt graphic in the “Banking Fees” section.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn SmartArt.  2) SmartArt Design > SmartArt Styles > Moderate Effect.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the SmartArt.  2) SmartArt Design > SmartArt Styles > Moderate Effect.

cham.de_bai: Apply the Moderate Effect SmartArt style to the SmartArt graphic in the “Banking Fees” section.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Bỏ đường lưới chính (major gridlines) khỏi biểu đồ trong mục “Contact Us”.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Remove the major gridlines from the chart in the “Contact Us” section.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn biểu đồ.  2) Chart Design > Add Chart Element > Gridlines > bấm Primary Major Vertical để bỏ chọn.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the chart.  2) Chart Design > Add Chart Element > Gridlines > click Primary Major Vertical to clear it.

cham.de_bai: Remove the major gridlines from the chart in the “Contact Us” section.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Welcome”, tại đoạn trống, chèn ảnh Bank_photo.png từ thư mục Files.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Welcome” section, in the blank paragraph, insert the Bank_photo.png picture from the Files folder.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ vào đoạn trống cuối section.  2) Insert > Pictures > This Device > mở thư mục Files của bộ đề > chọn Bank_photo.png > Insert.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Put the cursor in the blank paragraph at the end of the section.  2) Insert > Pictures > This Device > open the Files folder of the exam > choose Bank_photo.png > Insert.

cham.de_bai: In the “Welcome” section, in the blank paragraph, insert the Bank_photo.png picture from the Files folder.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Savings Account”, đổi kiểu ngắt dòng (text wrapping) của ảnh thành Through.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Savings Account” section, change the text wrapping for the picture to Through.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn ảnh.  2) Picture Format > Wrap Text > Through.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the picture.  2) Picture Format > Wrap Text > Through.

cham.de_bai: In the “Savings Account” section, change the text wrapping for the picture to Through.
